tyres.rule: Only KA-approved tyres from official suppliers. Class lists the compound. Air only. No mixing dry+wet. One set = 2F+2R.

suppliers.LeCont: Patrizicorse (SVB/SVC now renamed — use current spec papers)

tyres.meeting_allocation: From first qualifying: 1 dry set + 1 wet set (+ 1 replacement each if approved). State Championship: nominate/mark wets before first wet session.
tyres.wet_declaration: Clerk of the Course declares Wet before wets may be used.

fuel.no_mix: Do not mix unlike fuels. Same-profile pump brands may be mixed.
fuel.rok_gp: Pump Fuel or Unleaded Racing Fuel

oils_2stroke: Penrite 10 Tenths Race Castor 20W-40 full synthetic castor
Penrite KO2ST001 Two Stroke 10 Tenths Ko2st (full synthetic)
Oils named in the engine homologation
